$description: Empathia design tokens v2 (LEI P1). Two themes: Graphite (dark, from the V2.5.3 demonstrator's warm graphite and its teal) and Paper (light, its own composition on a warm paper ground, not an inversion). Teal is the interaction accent only (D8); the nine products keep vibrant colours of their own in the canonical order (D37/D40); statuses always travel with a word or a shape. build-tokens.mjs turns this file into dist/tokens.css, dist/tokens.js and dist/fonts.css; edit this file, never the generated CSS. Contrast is enforced by packages/design-tokens/test/contrast.test.mjs in both themes.
$source: legacy V2.5.3 offline HTML (:root graphite, --teal #45cfc1); docs/phase3/LEI_DECISIONS.md D7, D8, D9, D10, D36, D37, D38

line3.role: boundaries of controls that must be seen (≥ 3:1 on panel, WCAG 1.4.11)

tx3.role: muted text (≥ 4.5:1 on every ground in both themes)

accent.role: THE interaction accent: links, primary buttons, focus, selection, 'you are here' (D8). Never a product or status colour.

accent-ink.role: text and icons on an accent fill

ok.role: status: verified / good (always with a word or shape)

serious.role: the serious tone: safety, irreversible actions, legal notices; quieter than a status, never playful

product.$description: The nine products in the canonical order (D37, D40). id = the CSS suffix (--p-<id>) and the key in packages/ui/src/products.ts. Every value is ≥ 4.5:1 on bg, panel and panel2 in its theme (usable as text) and ≥ 3:1 on bg2. Hues are spread around the wheel with the accent's teal left free.

class.$description: Equipment class colours on plans and spatial stages (--c-<id>), carried from the V2.5.3 Build a Room plan palette. ≥ 3:1 on bg2 (the plan ground) in both themes; on a stage (D36) the dark values apply.

evidence.$description: The eight evidence states of the founder program (directive section 2.3). One hue ramp per state family; every chip also carries its word.

font.sans: "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
font.display: "Inter Display", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
font.serif: ui-serif, "New York", "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
font.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

fontFaces.$description: Self-hosted Inter (SIL OFL 1.1, from the machine's fonts-inter OTF), subset to Latin and shipped as WOFF2 in packages/design-tokens/fonts (regenerate with make-fonts.mjs). preload: the faces each surface preloads (D38: the website preloads three, ≈ 88 KB; the apps two).

type.$description: A 1.2 modular scale from 15 px body (the demonstrator's body size). Display sizes are for Inter Display 800 with tight tracking (D7).

target.$description: Minimum hit target on phones (WCAG 2.2 AA asks 24 px; the program asks 44).
